I have new samples, racks, and Serum 2 presets for you this month, including lots of rim shots. I really tried to craft the perfect rim shots. I feel like I managed to check all these

From FWD>> to film scores — @pinch_tectonic on how early dubstep crept into the soundtrack of ‘Children of Men’ 🎥
Although I talk about music every day, I rarely get the chance to discuss film, so I was lucky to explore both when I asked Pinch how his debut Tectonic release, ‘War Dub,’ along with other early dubstep classics like ‘Anti War Dub,’ ended up on the soundtrack of the 2006 film Children of Men.

first_line: Out Now // Tectonic Sound
caption:
Out Now // Tectonic Sound
“More so than just the sound, the music is in tune with the real ethos of the early dubstep scene. People talk about ‘heads in a scene - but it’s led by hearts really. I’ve always tried to follow my heart when it comes to music and all the music here is from people I trust to do something worth communicating with the world. It feels like Tectonic has been a part of many communities over the years, and there is something that binds all the releases together, something that speaks for itself in a way that goes beyond words, something that’s instinctive and immediate.” -

first_line: Working with soil, the land, and eating the rewards of the work has become easily my most inspiring piece of this existence that I have discovered in the last decade and a half.
caption:
Working with soil, the land, and eating the rewards of the work has become easily my most inspiring piece of this existence that I have discovered in the last decade and a half.
Most people think you need a big piece of land to garden, but the truth is, the only hard part is starting.
Whether you live in an apartment, or a duplex, have a small yard, or a big one. You have to start somewhere. And honestly, the smaller you begin, the easier it is to learn about what your plants like, and what you like.
Put a couple planters by the window in your place if you don't have a yard, or on your porch.

caption:
THE RUTHLESS EP IS OUT TONIGHT!
this EP itself is an origin story, but my favorite part has go to be the intro to “There Is No Tomorrow”
“There Is No Tomorrow” is not just a heavy dubstep record, but much more to me personally. since I was a kid my dad introduced me to watching Rocky movies almost every Sunday. It was like our motivational fuel through the next week, and still as an adult there are moments that stick with me forever from the Rocky movies. The one that stuck out to me the most is from Rocky III where Rocky and Apollo train, and Rocky’s basically giving up in subtle ways. Rocky

first_line: Story time :
caption:
Story time :
In 2012, I stumbled across a motocross video with the Adventure Club Remix of Crave you as the audio. It literally blew me away what I was hearing.
At the time, I was listening to mainly Trap and Big Room on YouTube, but this melodic dubstep vibe was just so fresh.
I credit this song as getting me into bass music, and I wanted this remix to do the og justice. I teetered on a few different versions over the last year, but this one I landed in recently felt so good.
What yall think?
@adventureclub
@flightfac

first_line: The Adventure Club remix of Crave You is what put me on a dubstep 10+ years ago. I pretty much credit this track to putting me onto the trajectory that I’m on today and it’s with the most respect that I put my all into this remix.
caption:
The Adventure Club remix of Crave You is what put me on a dubstep 10+ years ago. I pretty much credit this track to putting me onto the trajectory that I’m on today and it’s with the most respect that I put my all into this remix.
I know the OG is a classic that a lot of people hold close to them so I hope you can take my version as a sign of appreciation and not that it needed to be changed.
It’s up now on SoundCloud ❤️💙❤️💙
Big respect to @adventureclub and @flightfac
